away_score.instructions: Evaluate only the row whose field equals away_score. actual means broadcast reference; preview means offline proposal. If both actual_ink and preview_ink are true, missing_element is forbidden. Choose none when the provided residual is within and the hues agree. A hue mismatch permits wrong_tint. A luminance-only near/far residual is wrong_tint rather than evidence of blur, size, occlusion or missing glyphs. A panel with no glyph ink is not a missing panel. Use misplaced only when native_evidence specifically identifies placement for this field. The network field is known to be pinned inward. Do not invent engine causes.
